peopleAreSaying.description: Cards from Google's "What people are saying" / "Trending posts and discussions" SERP module. The field is omitted from `result` when no such module appears on the SERP, so clients should treat it as optional rather than expecting an empty array.

title.description: Card title as displayed on the SERP

link.description: Destination URL the card points to (often a Reddit, Quora, or community forum thread)

date.description: Google's raw relative-time text (e.g., "5 days ago", "2 weeks ago"). Free-form string — not normalized to a timestamp.

redirectLink.description: Google's `/goto` redirect for this link, in the absolute form `POST /v1/monitor/google/goto` accepts. Present only when Google served the link as a redirect — the sibling link field holds the destination cloro resolved it to.

localResults.description: Places from Google's local pack (the map-backed "3-pack" of local businesses on local-intent queries, e.g. "best pizza in new york city"). The field is omitted from `result` when no local pack appears on the SERP, so clients should treat it as optional rather than expecting an empty array. Desktop only; mobile and the separate hotels/travel pack are not surfaced.

title.description: Business name as displayed on the SERP

placeId.description: Google entity id for the place

reviews.description: Review count as displayed by Google (e.g. "26K"). Free-form string — not normalized to a number.

price.description: Price band as displayed by Google (e.g. "$10–20"). Currency symbol matches the locale.

yearsInBusiness.description: Years-in-business badge, when shown (typical on service-style packs)

address.description: Street address or locality as displayed on the SERP

hours.description: Opening-hours text as displayed (e.g. "Open · Closes 11 PM", "Open 24 hours")

description.description: Trailing snippet — a review quote or a service-options line

links.description: Action links rendered on the place, typically on business/service-style packs (plumbers, salons, …) and absent on restaurant packs whose places are plain buttons. Each key is present only when Google rendered that button.

redirectLink.description: Google's `/goto` redirect for this link, in the absolute form `POST /v1/monitor/google/goto` accepts. Present only when Google served the link as a redirect — the sibling link field holds the destination cloro resolved it to.

localResultsMoreLink.description: Absolute URL of the local pack's "More places" / "More businesses" control — Google's expanded Local Finder for the query. Returned only alongside `localResults` when the SERP renders the control.

link.description: Google search URL for the related query

ads.description: Sponsored ad results from Google search, including text ads (`type: RESULT`) and shopping-style sponsored cards (`type: SHOPPING_CARD`) from the right-hand-side and top-of-page carousels.

blockPosition.description: Where the ad appeared on the SERP. `top`/`bottom` are text-ad blocks, `middle` covers direct/in-content ads, `rhs` is the right-hand-side sponsored-products carousel.

type.description: Discriminates plain text ads (`RESULT`) from shopping-style sponsored cards (`SHOPPING_CARD`). Shopping cards appear in the right-hand-side PLA carousel, the top-of-page PLA carousel, and the top-of-page sponsored shopping-card carousels (vehicles, products, hotels, …).

url.description: Destination URL of the ad. For `type: SHOPPING_CARD` items this is a Google `aclk?`-redirected URL.

page.description: Page number where the ad was found

displayedUrl.description: Formatted URL as displayed in the ad

description.description: Ad description text. For `type: RESULT` items this is classic ad copy. For `type: SHOPPING_CARD` items it carries category-specific subtitle fragments joined with `·` (e.g. vehicle condition + city: `Used - 94k miles · Greeley`).

category.description: Carousel header label for shopping-card ads. Examples observed today include `Sponsored products`, `Sponsored vehicles`, and `Sponsored hotels`. Omitted for `type: RESULT` text ads.

price.description: Product price for `type: SHOPPING_CARD` ads. `currency` and `raw` are always present; `value` is omitted when the number doesn't parse, and the whole object is omitted when no currency appears beside a number. `raw` carries the visible text verbatim (e.g. `"$0 down with 24 monthly payments"` on installment offers) so consumers can disambiguate genuine zero prices from down-payment labels.

oldPrice.description: Original price before discount on `type: SHOPPING_CARD` ads that surface MSRP / sale messaging. Same shape as `price`.

store.description: Merchant/dealer name attached to a `type: SHOPPING_CARD` ad.

imageUrl.description: Hero image URL served by Google's `encrypted-tbn` CDN for `type: SHOPPING_CARD` ads. Omitted when the lazy-image chain cannot resolve a non-placeholder source.

aioverview.description: Google AI Overview data (if requested). Omitted when Google shows no AI Overview for the query.

sources.description: Sources referenced in the AI Overview

label.description: Source title (the display label Google renders on the source rail)

redirectLink.description: Google's `/goto` redirect for this link, in the absolute form `POST /v1/monitor/google/goto` accepts. Present only when Google served the link as a redirect — the sibling link field holds the destination cloro resolved it to.

citationPills.description: Inline citation pills extracted from the AI Overview answer. Each entry is one (pill, source) pair: when a pill cites N sources (Google's `[Label +N]` chips), the array contains N entries sharing the same `citationPillId` but carrying per-source `label`, `url`, and `domain`. Group by `citationPillId` to recover the pill-level structure. Omitted from `result.aioverview` when the answer carries no pills.

label.description: Per-source title from the sources rail (for example `"Chase Personal Credit Cards"`). Empty string when the rail has no title for this source — consumers should read `domain` / `url` for source identity in that case. Entries grouped under the same `citationPillId` carry different per-source labels.

citationPillId.description: 1-based ordinal shared by all entries from the same chip. Group by `citationPillId` to reconstruct the visible chip; the per-source `label` differs across entries within a chip.

url.description: Direct URL of the cited source.

domain.description: Host extracted from `url`, for grouping and display.

description.description: Source description from the sources rail when Google ships one. Omitted when the source carries no snippet.

position.description: 1-based position of this source in the sibling `result.aioverview.sources` array.

redirectLink.description: Google's `/goto` redirect for this link, in the absolute form `POST /v1/monitor/google/goto` accepts. Present only when Google served the link as a redirect — the sibling link field holds the destination cloro resolved it to.

relatedLinks.description: A citation chip's "View related links" flyout items — URLs Google groups under the chip that are NOT in the `sources` rail (for example a Google Shopping comparison link). Each entry shares the `citationPillId` of its chip so it can be grouped with that chip's `citationPills`, but carries no `position` (a related link is absent from `sources`). Related links also render inline in `markdown`, so `markdown` may contain more URLs than `sources` / `citationPills` — the extras are accounted for here. Omitted from `result.aioverview` when no chip carries related links.

label.description: The related page's own title. Empty string when Google ships none — read `domain` / `url` for identity in that case.

citationPillId.description: Matches the `citationPillId` of the chip's `citationPills` entries, so a related link can be grouped with its pill.

url.description: Direct URL of the related link.

domain.description: Host extracted from `url`, for grouping and display.

description.description: Snippet Google ships for the related link. Omitted when absent.

redirectLink.description: Google's `/goto` redirect for this link, in the absolute form `POST /v1/monitor/google/goto` accepts. Present only when Google served the link as a redirect — the sibling link field holds the destination cloro resolved it to.

type.description: Sub-type discriminator. TEXT ads carry `domain` + `description`; SHOPPING ads carry `price` + `store` (+ optional `old_price`). Always present.

domain.description: Domain name of the advertiser (present when `type` is `TEXT`)

price.description: Product price (present when `type` is `SHOPPING`). `currency` and `raw` are always present; `value` is omitted when the number doesn't parse, and the whole object is omitted when no currency appears beside a number. `raw` carries the visible text verbatim.

old_price.description: Original price before discount (present when `type` is `SHOPPING` and the ad has sale pricing). Same shape as `price`.

image.description: Ad image URL (product photo for shopping ads, hero image for text ads)

shoppingCards.description: Shopping product cards extracted from the SERP's organic shopping grids ("Popular products" / "More products"). The field is omitted from `result` when no shopping section is present, so clients should treat it as optional rather than expecting an empty array. Cards carry no product URL: they open a Google-side overlay rather than an external page.

position.description: 1-indexed rank across the whole `shoppingCards` array in DOM order (flat, does not reset per `category` section).

promoLabel.description: Discount badge as displayed by Google, in the SERP language (for example "LOW PRICE", "OFERTA", "PROMOÇÃO", "20% OFF"). Google renders it above the product name on a discounted card. Present only on a card that carries the badge, and Google-only — AI Mode does not render it.

category.description: Parent section header text. Lets callers distinguish cards from coexisting shopping panels on the same SERP. Current Google-emitted values include "Popular products" and "More products".

price.description: Structured pricing information. `currency` and `raw` are always present; `value` is omitted when the number doesn't parse, and the whole object is omitted when no currency appears beside a number. `raw` carries the visible text verbatim.

oldPrice.description: Original price before discount. Same shape as `price`.
